title: Chemical Equilibrium
description: A reaction runs both ways at once, and settles where ΔG° = −RT ln K. Heat it and it goes faster, but an exothermic one settles further back. Unlocks the Iron Catalyst and the Haber-Bosch Reactor.

puzzle.goal: A reaction gives out heat H (negative) and changes the entropy by S. Write its equilibrium constant K at temperature T, with the gas constant R.
puzzle.name: Gibbs relation
puzzle.form: exp ( - ( H - T * S ) / ( R * T ) )
puzzle.expr: exp ( - ( H - T * S ) / ( R * T ) )
puzzle.ask: Find K for ammonia: H = −92400 J/mol, S = −198 J/(mol·K), R = 8.314 J/(mol·K), T = @{T} K.
puzzle.method: ΔG° = ΔH − TΔS, and at equilibrium ΔG° = −RT ln K.
